artifact_observations.reasoning: Watermark text 'JEWELRYTOUR.COM' is present. While legible, AI-generated text often has slight kerning or edge artifacts. Here it looks relatively clean but warrants verification.
Some links immediately adjacent to the pendant setting appear slightly fused or less distinct than those further away, suggesting minor geometric ambiguity in complex overlapping regions.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a necklace and distinguish specific jewelry types/materials.
To verify that individual chain links are closed loops and not fused together, and that gemstone settings are structurally sound.
To ensure the necklace sits physically on top of the bust with correct contact shadows and no floating elements.
To analyze the legibility and structural integrity of the watermark text in the corner.
To assess overall sharpness, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle generative blurring.

focus_areas: Integrity of individual chain links (no fusion)
Realism of metal reflections and specular highlights
Structural plausibility of the pendant setting (prongs holding stones)
Contact shadows between necklace and display bust
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the connection points between the pendant and the chain. AI often struggles with small mechanical connections like jump rings. Verify if the 'fusion' noted in artifacts is actual structural failure or just depth-of-field blur. Check if the watermark text is perfectly formed or has characteristic AI letter distortions.
